optimizedContext.value:
# Error Handling Conventions

## Rules
- Specd Error Contract: extends `Error`; `readonly specd = true`; `readonly code: string`; descriptive `message`
- `@specd/core`: canonical `SpecdError` base; all domain/application errors MUST extend it
- All monorepo packages depending on `@specd/core`: extend `SpecdError`; SHOULD define package-level base (e.g. `SpecdCliError`)
- Error codes: `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`; unique per package; stable across versions
- Messages: descriptive, actionable; no jargon or internal details
- Optional metadata (`specId`, `filePath`, etc.) for JSON/TOON; document in JSDoc
- Error classes: JSDoc with meaning, `code`, metadata; use cases document `@throws`

## Constraints
- System errors (OOM, network) and unexpected bugs MAY stay generic `Error` (CLI shows stack trace)
- Domain logic MUST NOT use generic `Error` for expected/validation failures
